description: Independent synthetic holdout written after fixing the neutral reference mean; no training or threshold fitting. Includes related distractor pairs.

passages.text: Domain name resolution. A distributed directory maps human-readable website names to numeric internet addresses through cached authoritative records.
HTTP communication. A web client sends a method and path to a server, which returns a status code, headers and optionally a response body.
Logistic regression classification. A linear combination of input features is transformed into a probability to choose between discrete categories.
Linear regression prediction. A fitted weighted sum estimates a continuous numerical outcome and minimizes squared prediction errors.
Musical rhythm. Repeated beats and durations organize when notes begin, with tempo controlling how quickly the pulse repeats.
Musical harmony. Several notes sounding together form chords, and movement between chords creates tension and resolution.
Plant photosynthesis. Leaves capture sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into sugars while releasing oxygen.
The water cycle. Liquid evaporates into the atmosphere, condenses into clouds and returns to the surface as precipitation.
Version-control merging. Independent changes from two development branches are combined, with conflicting edits resolved before recording the result.
Plate tectonics. Large pieces of the Earth's crust move slowly, colliding, separating or sliding to form mountains and ocean trenches.
